artifacts.summary: Scheduled Recipe validation dispatch refactor evidence.

evidence.observation: The source audit maps the current path OpenVisionShellHostView -> RecipeCommandSurface command -> Surface scope branch -> existing execution-session workflow. The Surface branch contains only scope selection, two start-status strings, and forwarding calls; the execution session already owns IsValidationSuiteRunning, StopRequested, StatusText, ExecutionStatusText, BatchRunSaved, CommandStateChanged, and selected/local/pair/catalog execution. The existing command, binding, CanExecute, and Shell lifetime contracts remain at the Surface; the moved dispatch will pass scope and selected snapshots to the existing execution owner. The complete owner map and static search outputs are in owner-map.txt, dispatch-call-path.txt, session-state-owner.txt, and surface-selection-owner.txt.

OpenVisionRecipeExecutionSessionViewModel.RunValidationSuiteAsync now owns LocalValidationSet, GoodBadPair, Catalog, and default selected-sample dispatch and reuses the existing workflow methods. RecipeCommandSurface delegates through executionSession.RunValidationSuiteAsync, retains RunValidationSuiteCommand/CanRunValidationSuite and all binding projections, and no longer contains the old status strings or RunLocalValidationSetAsync/RunSelectedSampleValidationSuiteAsync wrappers. The source proof and diff check are recorded in source-proof.txt and git-diff-check.txt.

Solution Debug and VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug x64 builds passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. The valid copied-runtime Recipe execution session dispatch contract passed 13/13; validation evidence passed 4/4; step preview navigation passed 5/5; Shell Recipe basic lifecycle passed 7/7; RefreshOptions command-state projection passed 1/1. The focused summary and build logs are in the M3 evidence directory; WPF visual theme/DPI/monitor/input, hardware/camera/SDK/GPU, and long-running native shutdown remain unverified.

The final source audit records the active RecipeCommandSurface caller, the single OpenVisionRecipeExecutionSessionViewModel dispatch owner, the mutable-state writers, Shell/session lifetime, XAML/public contract, shortest reading route, Recipe folders, protected framework/XAML partials, and absence of stale forwarding wrappers. The handoff and codebase navigation records were updated. M3 builds and focused contracts passed; WPF runtime visual/theme/DPI/monitor/input, hardware/camera/SDK/GPU, and long-running native shutdown remain unverified.
